2390-6191-6661.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-6191-6661.description:
Gain life.
Minwu triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Cleric you control
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3800-4474-4687.notablePrerequisites: Iceberg has at least four counters on it.
3800-4474-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Iceberg.
Activate Iceberg as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Iceberg, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7159.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7159.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

567-997-1981-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
567-997-1981-2415.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7736-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2438-3263-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
2438-3263-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Mycosynth Lattice and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Carrion Feeder.

1115-2034-6723-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

2043-4659-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing three of the tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat
2043-4659-7826.notes: If you keep a Food each loop by sacrificing the Bag End Banquet token, the original Bag End Banquet can then be tapped for infinite {C}.

1895-4399-4518-6752.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Haliya trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4518-6752.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

338-475-549-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-475-549-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1355-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-1355-6633.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5256-5542-6136.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6136.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Avenging Hunter from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Avenging Hunter.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Avenging Hunter token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6136.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3525-4474-7734.description:
Activate Wakandan Tusker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wakandan Tusker triggers, causing you to scry 1 and gain 1 life
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Wakandan Tusker.
Repeat.

140-3245-4417.description:
Activate Hex Parasite by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

1988-2099-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1988-2099-3490-7426.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat

2079-4613-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
2079-4613-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2079-4613-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

5147-6529-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2366-5929-6797-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5929-6797-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1003-5220-5683-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Phyrexian Walker and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

856-2279-5226-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

1789-5649-5686-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-5649-5686-5929.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

643-1429-5231-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-1429-5231-5402.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {R}.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

813-2061-2104.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
813-2061-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5078-5642.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Birgi and Echoes of Eternity trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Echoes of Eternity trigger, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1365-4853-5330-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-4853-5330-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1909-4486-5833.notablePrerequisites: Leafkin Druid does not have summoning sickness. You control four or more creatures.
1909-4486-5833.description:
Activate Leafkin Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Leafkin Druid.
Repeat.

509-1267-2392-3933.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-2392-3933.easyPrerequisites: Silverskin Armor attached to Medomai the Ageless.
509-1267-2392-3933.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-2392-3933.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

802-1671-2556-3400-3664.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field by tapping them, adding {G}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting Mnemonic Wall.
Ivy triggers, copying Snap, targeting Ivy.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Ivy from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field by tapping them, adding {G}{U} and three mana of any color.
Resolve Snap, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field.
Cast Ivy by paying {G}{U}.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying {4}{U}.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Snap from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1418-1467-3634-4377.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1418-1467-3634-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Walk the Aeons.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Walk the Aeons to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1778-4050-4871-5105.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {1}.
When Memnite dies, Sigil of the New Dawn and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Sigil of the New Dawn trigger, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Memnite to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

231-661-3281-3390.description:
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping it and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {3}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Great Furnace.
Activate Sculpting Steel by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Tameshi's second ability by paying {W} and returning Sculpting Steel from the battlefield to your hand.
If it has not triggered this turn, Tameshi's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Tameshi's second ability, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

233-714-5158.description:
All lands are swamps with Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth.
All swamps are 1/1 creatures with Kormus bell.
All opponent creatures get -2/-2 from Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite.
Each opponent lands can not be played.

618-2905.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Pestermite with haste.
When the Pestermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki
Repeat.
